tool_limitations.limitation: It crawled only the project directory and ignored csproj items linked from SharedContent and sibling folders.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Resolve Compile/ApplicationDefinition/Page/Content/AppxManifest items with Link metadata and copy them to their Link paths before namespace rewrite and inventory.

tool_limitations.limitation: A native stowed exception without a .NET event 1026 stack yields only a broad cause class.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Keep the generic hint, but ensure bootstrap completeness prevents missing linked XAML/resources from reaching startup.

tool_limitations.limitation: It warned on the bootstrap's own '(none)' deferred-file sentinel.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Treat the '(none)' row as an empty, consistent deferred list.

failed_apis.why_tried: SKILL.md prescribed it as the compile command.
failed_apis.root_cause: The installed winapp CLI supports run but not build.
failed_apis.fix: Use dotnet build against the explicit csproj and x64 platform.

failed_apis.why_tried: The threading pattern replaced CoreDispatcher callbacks with DispatcherQueue.
failed_apis.root_cause: using Windows.System and Microsoft.UI.Dispatching made the unqualified type ambiguous.
failed_apis.fix: Fully qualify Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue for the field and GetForCurrentThread call.

failed_apis.why_tried: Shared shell status brushes were manually reconstructed from UWP code.
failed_apis.root_cause: Windows.UI.Colors is not the WinUI 3 namespace.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build guidance
doc_errors.correct: Use dotnet build <project.csproj> -p:Platform=x64; winapp has no build command.

doc_errors.wrong: Prefer scaffold manifest images even when source branding exists.
doc_errors.correct: Prefer resolvable source branding for fidelity; use scaffold assets only as a documented fallback.

special_apis.special_handling: Watcher events arrive off the UI thread; cache Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue on the UI thread and enqueue collection/button updates.
Resolve Include plus Link metadata, including project properties such as SharedContentDir, then copy the external source to the linked target path before migration.
Every StaticResource/ThemeResource dictionary referenced by copied XAML must be carried over and merged; a missing dictionary can build but crash during XAML activation.

errors_encountered.error: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: Target not found; Test-Path returned False.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check were issued concurrently, so bootstrap ran before dotnet new completed.
errors_encountered.fix: Re-run bootstrap after scaffold completion and serialize the three mandatory commands.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Incorrect skill guidance for the installed CLI.
errors_encountered.fix: Switch to dotnet build with the explicit project path.

errors_encountered.error: MSB1003: current working directory does not contain a project or solution.
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet build was run from the parent app directory rather than against UserInfo.csproj.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch status=unavailable: no build output under bin\x64\Debug.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Launch was issued concurrently with a failed/default-platform build.
errors_encountered.fix: Build x64 successfully before invoking the launch helper.

errors_encountered.error: XAML compiler input.json was in use by another process.
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet build and dotnet run compiled the same project concurrently.
errors_encountered.fix: Run build, launch, and validation sequentially.

errors_encountered.error: CS0101/CS0102/CS0111 duplicate Scenario, UserViewModel, scenarios, FEATURE_NAME, and GetUserViewModelsAsync.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Missing linked MainPage/shared files were manually recreated while SampleConfiguration.cs still defined the same partial members and helper types.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove duplicate definitions; the durable fix is to bootstrap linked project items instead of reconstructing them.

errors_encountered.error: CS0104: DispatcherQueue is ambiguous between Microsoft.UI.Dispatching and Windows.System.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The migrated file retained using Windows.System and used an unqualified replacement type.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909/WMC1111 could not resolve local:Scenario and x:Bind DataType; cascading WMC9999.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The manually reconstructed shell had conflicting/unresolved local type declarations.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove duplicates and temporarily use Binding; bootstrapping the original linked MainPage avoids reconstruction.

errors_encountered.root_cause: A stale UWP color namespace remained in manually reconstructed shell code.

errors_encountered.error: CS2012 and WMC9999 while validator rebuilt intermediate XAML assemblies.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Build, launch, and validator processes ran concurrently and locked obj/bin outputs.
errors_encountered.fix: Stop the specific locking processes and serialize subsequent commands.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The linked shared Styles.xaml dictionary was not copied or merged, leaving shell StaticResource references unresolved at activation.
errors_encountered.fix: Copy/adapt the shared styles and merge the dictionary; the durable fix is linked-item bootstrap support.

errors_encountered.root_cause: A concurrently launched app held the output DLL.
errors_encountered.fix: Do not build while the launch helper or app is using the same output.

errors_encountered.error: Validator warned that MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md had content with no defer rows.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The initializer writes a '(none)' table row while the validator recognized only prose saying 'No items deferred'.
errors_encountered.fix: Accept the initializer's empty sentinel in the validator.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Bootstrap failed and both self-checks initially printed False.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The required dependent commands were parallelized.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Waited for dotnet new, reran bootstrap, then read the mapping.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Explicitly require the scaffold/bootstrap/self-check commands to run sequentially.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent deleted/recreated MainPage and scenario XAML, copied shared media manually, and duplicated types.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap missed 17 csproj-linked shared files and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Manually recreated/copied a subset and removed duplicate SampleConfiguration definitions.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Resolve and copy linked MSBuild items in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Unsupported winapp command, wrong working-directory build, concurrent build/run lock, then 11 compiler/XAML errors.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Wrong build documentation, non-serialized commands, and missing linked source structure.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Used explicit dotnet build, qualified DispatcherQueue, removed duplicate types, and fixed namespace/XAML errors.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Correct build command guidance, sequential command discipline, and linked-item bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated CS2012/WMC9999 locks and three 0xc000027b startup-crash reports.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 18 turns including 3 launch attempts and 3 validator attempts
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Commands continued in parallel, while the missing shared Styles.xaml caused the real startup failure.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Stopped specific processes, added the styles dictionary, and let the final validator run complete.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Serialize build/launch/validation and include linked resource dictionaries during bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: All behavior worked, but all three features remained partial due to light theme, project-name title, and placeholder icon.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The source RequestedTheme and branded linked assets were missed, while scaffold title/icon values were retained.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the migrated app.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Make source theme/title/icon shell invariants explicit and prefer source branding.

missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Manual reconstruction of MainPage, App, styles, and assets; duplicate type errors; missing-resource startup crashes; and the theme/icon parity regression.

env_issues.issue: Installed winapp CLI lacks a build command.
env_issues.workaround: Use dotnet build with the explicit csproj.

env_issues.issue: WinUI XAML compiler and running app lock shared obj/bin files.
env_issues.workaround: Run build, launch, and validation sequentially and stop only the specific app/compiler process when recovering.
